note.question: How should regulators charge warehouses for truck emissions, and how will a strategic trucking company price electric service when heterogeneous warehouse routes can switch between diesel and electric trucks?
note.overview: Warehouses strategically choose truck technology after a trucking company sets the electric-truck rental price; the base game is Stackelberg and the competition extension contains a Cournot equilibrium.
